title: Total Quality Management: Main Exam, 15 April 2019
instructions: ANSWER ALL QUESTIONS IN SECTION A AND ANY OTHER TWO FROM SECTION B

parts.text: List FOUR characteristics of a quality leader.
State THREE tangible and THREE intangible benefits that an organization will enjoy as a result of embracing total quality management.
Differentiate between benchmarking and quality audit.
Explain why Six Sigma quality control is considered unique by organizations that embrace total quality management.
Explain the importance of standards in software development.
Explain some of the methods that can be used to identify external customers' expectations.
Discuss the obstacles of total quality management.
Discuss the benefits of ISO (International Organization for Standardization).
Quality can be evaluated on multiple dimensions. Explain how organizations can use these dimensions for strategic competitiveness.
Discuss the specific dimensions of service quality.
Discuss the merits and demerits of business process re-engineering (BPR).
Describe the various classifications of typical quality costs.
Explain the steps involved in the benchmarking process in quality management.
Explain computer-aided quality control.
Outline the following terms as applied in quality process planning.
Brainstorming
Pareto analysis
Ishikawa diagrams
Checklists

A defence contractor manufactures rifles for the military. The military has exacting quality standards that the contractor must meet. The military is very pleased with the quality of the products provided by the contractor. However, the contractor is experiencing high quality-related costs. Discuss the reasons for the contractor's high quality-related costs.
